ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu; TIES Cohort 1 or Cohort 2. External Education is located in the heart of University Village on UIC's South Campus. Offices are at 1333 S. Halsted, Suite 205 about 1.5 blocks south of Roosevelt on the southeast corner of Halsted & Maxwell. The entrance is approximately a 1/2 block south of Maxwell on the east side of the street (across from Quizno's and Caribou Coffee). This is a secure building; please follow instructions posted at the entry to gain access. To gain access to suite 205, walk up to the second floor, northwest side of the building. People will also need to be "buzzed" into the office by the proctor. Conference room 221 is within the office suite. Parking vouchers are available at a discount rate for the Maxwell Street Parking Structure (located just around the corner from the building).
